headline: Moody's Downgrades Senegal Sovereign Rating to Ca
summary: Moody's downgraded Senegal's sovereign foreign-currency rating to Ca from Caa2. This follows Dakar's announcement that it intends to utilize the G20 Common Framework for debt treatment.
why: Sovereign credit ratings assess a government's ability to service debt, directly influencing borrowing costs on international capital markets and foreign investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Senegal
impacts.why: Sovereign credit downgrade indicates higher default risk and increases government borrowing costs.
